name: Update Beat
summary: Change the description, type, or schedule of an existing beat by ID.
description: Updates an existing beat. Use **List Beats** first if the ID is unknown. Any of description, type, cron schedule, or notification channel/target can be changed independently.

params.name: id
params.description: The UUID of the beat to update.

params.name: cron_expression
params.description: New 5-field cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1" (every Monday at 9am).

params.name: channel
params.description: New channel for the beat, if it should notify a different chat. Must be provided together with target.

params.name: target
params.description: New recipient address (Telegram chat id or WhatsApp JID) for the beat. Must be provided together with channel.

pt-br.summary: Altera a descrição, o tipo ou o agendamento de um beat existente pelo ID.
pt-br.description: Atualiza um beat existente. Use antes o **List Beats** se o ID não for conhecido. Descrição, tipo, agendamento cron ou canal/destino de notificação podem ser alterados de forma independente.
